# pve_acme_meta (Data Source)

ACME CA metadata: directory meta, terms of service, and challenge type schemas.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "pve_acme_meta" "example" {
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `directory` (String) URL of ACME CA directory endpoint. (default: https://acme-v02.api.letsencrypt.org/directory)

### Read-Only

- `challenge_schemas` (Attributes List) Returned by /cluster/acme/challenge-schema. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--challenge_schemas))
- `id` (String) Identifier: .
- `index` (String) Raw JSON payload returned by /cluster/acme (the API schema does not describe its shape).
- `meta` (Attributes) (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--meta))
- `tos` (String)

<a id="nestedatt--challenge_schemas"></a>
### Nested Schema for `challenge_schemas`

Read-Only:

- `api_id` (String)
- `name` (String) Human readable name, falls back to id
- `schema` (Attributes) (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--challenge_schemas--schema))
- `type` (String)

<a id="nestedatt--challenge_schemas--schema"></a>
### Nested Schema for `challenge_schemas.schema`



<a id="nestedatt--meta"></a>
### Nested Schema for `meta`

Read-Only:

- `caaidentities` (List of String) Hostnames referring to the ACME servers.
- `externalaccountrequired` (Boolean) EAB Required
- `termsofservice` (String) ACME TermsOfService URL.
- `website` (String) URL to more information about the ACME server.
